sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents and perused the material available on record.w 2.

Present petition has been filed with following main prayers:-
"i. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari thereby quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 15.09.2017 lodged by the opposite party no. 4 in Case Crime No. 0620 of 2017 Under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC and Section 60/72 of the UP Commercial Tax/Excise Act Police Station Kotwali District Sultanpur contained in Annexure no. 1 to this writ petition so far it relates to the petitioner.
ii. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus thereby commanding and directing the opposite parties not to arrest the petitioner in pursuance of the Manoj Patildar @ Manoj Patidar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt. ...

sentences.text: 3. Learned AGA states on the basis of instructions that the alleged certificate of Excise Department is not issued by the Department.

4. After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the petitioner prays to withdraw the present writ petition with liberty to the petitioner to take appropriate proceedings before any other appropriate Court in accordance with law.
5. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the same.
6. With the aforesaid liberty, the present writ petition is consigned to record as withdrawn.
